compound.name: wogonin
compound.one_liner: 8-Methoxy flavone of both skullcaps; a benzodiazepine-site modulator (Ki 0.92 µM) that was anxiolytic in mice without sedation.

biosynthesis.note: Made in S. baicalensis roots via FNSII-2 [28].

occurrences.source_citation: Lin L-Z, Harnly JM, Upton R (2009) Comparison of the phenolic component profiles of skullcap (Scutellaria lateriflora) and germander (Teucrium canadense and T. chamaedrys), a potentially hepatotoxic adulterant. Phytochem Anal 20(4):298-306
occurrences.note: LOTUS LTS0176185 lists S. lateriflora (refs decoded as 10.1021/np0205102 and 10.1021/np900068t). Lin 2009 lists wogonin among flavonoids positively identified in authenticated S. lateriflora aerial parts; no mg/g given.

occurrences.source_citation: Cosmetic Ingredient Review Expert Panel (2020) Safety Assessment of Scutellaria baicalensis-Derived Ingredients as Used in Cosmetics, final report 29 Sep 2020 (citing Cai et al. 2016). https://www.cir-safety.org/sites/default/files/scutel092020FR_0.pdf
occurrences.database: Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases
occurrences.note: CIR/Cai 2016: 30.5 mg/g aqueous root extract. Costine 2022: wogonin detected in roots of all four species studied. KNApSAcK C00001111. | Basis as recorded: ppm as listed by Duke (basis not stated per row; for 'Essent. Oil' parts it is ppm of the oil, 10000 ppm = 1 %) Basis (fresh/dry weight) not stated by the source; excluded from /compare until confirmed.

pharmacology.primary_targets: Benzodiazepine site of the GABA-A receptor (Ki 0.92 µM) [35].
pharmacology.mechanism: Positive allosteric modulation of GABA-A receptors via the benzodiazepine site; enhanced GABA-activated currents in rat neurons and recombinant receptors [35].

evidence.claim: Wogonin binds and positively modulates the GABA-A benzodiazepine site.
Wogonin is anxiolytic in mice without sedation or muscle relaxation.
evidence.test_article_detail: oral wogonin, elevated plus-maze, holeboard, wire test
evidence.outcome_summary: Anxiolytic comparable to diazepam; no sedation.

compound.teaching_note: Wogonin, apigenin and chrysin tell one story across two plant families: flavones at the benzodiazepine site [35, 36, 37].
gaps: No human evidence for the isolated compound found in this pass.
